title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
山東鄉試錄序
嘉靖己酉秋天下復當大比
之期山東之士試於提學僉
事李〔寵〕者凡二千四百有奇
畀集省下以來試于有司先
是巡按監察御史傅〔鎮〕舉故
事禮聘教授馮〔元〕學正王〔三〕
===
聘爲考試官教授梁〔以蘅〕教
諭蔡〔宗堯〕黃〔應升〕林〔元高〕袁
道〔大華〕趙〔栻〕曹爲同考試官
至則巡按監察御史劉〔瑤〕實
監臨之爰稽故典增飭新規
視昔尤加隆焉而以右參政
鮑〔象賢〕右參議萬〔虞愷〕爲提
punctuated:
山東鄉試錄序

嘉靖己酉秋，天下復當大比之期。山東之士試於提學僉事李〔寵〕者，凡二千四百有奇，畀集省下，以來試于有司。先是，巡按監察御史傅〔鎮〕舉故事，禮聘教授馮〔元〕、學正王〔三〕聘爲考試官，教授梁〔以蘅〕、教諭蔡〔宗堯〕、黃〔應升〕、林〔元高〕、袁道〔大華〕、趙〔栻〕、曹爲同考試官。至則巡按監察御史劉〔瑤〕實監臨之，爰稽故典，增飭新規，視昔尤加隆焉。而以右參政鮑〔象賢〕、右參議萬〔虞愷〕爲提
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Shandong Provincial Examination

In the autumn of the jiyou year of Jiajing (1549), the time for the triennial examination had again arrived throughout the realm. More than 2,400 scholars of Shandong had been examined by Li Chong, the Education Intendant holding the rank of Assistant Surveillance Commissioner. They were assembled [?] at the provincial capital to undergo examination by the responsible authorities. Previously, Fu Zhen, the Regional Inspector serving as Investigating Censor, had followed precedent and courteously invited Feng Yuan, a Prefectural School Professor, and Wang Sanpin, a Departmental School Instructor, to serve as Examiners. Liang Yiheng, a Prefectural School Professor, and the County School Instructors Cai Zongyao, Huang Yingsheng, Lin Yuangao, Yuan Dao (Dahua [?]), Zhao Shi, and Cao [?] were appointed Associate Examiners. Upon their arrival, Liu Yao, the Regional Inspector serving as Investigating Censor, undertook supervision as Supervising Official. Established precedents were consulted, and new regulations were further refined and enforced, making the arrangements still more imposing than before. Bao Xiangxian, Right Administration Vice Commissioner, and Wan Yukai, Right Administration Assistant Commissioner, were appointed Proctors…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
調官副使趙〔廷松〕僉事李〔嵩〕
爲監試官曁諸執事咸愼選
以充乃諏日入院三試之罔
不洗心滌慮以仰副
朝廷側席求賢之意登茲錄者
凡七十五人將計偕上春官
對
===
大廷爲太平之臣〔元〕也遭逢
聖主備員儒官亦欲竭尺寸以補
塞萬分之一茲獲叨與盛舉
庶幾少效以人事君之義顧
不大榮幸哉〔元〕惟
國家建制稽古右文推明孔子
之道以淑天下而六經語孟
punctuated:
調官，副使趙〔廷松〕、僉事李〔嵩〕爲監試官，曁諸執事，咸愼選以充。乃諏日入院，三試之，罔不洗心滌慮，以仰副朝廷側席求賢之意。登茲錄者凡七十五人，將計偕上春官，對大廷，爲太平之臣。
〔元〕也遭逢聖主，備員儒官，亦欲竭尺寸，以補塞萬分之一。茲獲叨與盛舉，庶幾少效以人事君之義，顧不大榮幸哉！〔元〕惟國家建制，稽古右文，推明孔子之道，以淑天下，而六經、語、孟
translation_en:
…Proctors. Zhao Tingsong, Surveillance Vice Commissioner, and Li Song, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, were appointed Examination Overseers; all the other functionaries were likewise carefully selected to fill their posts. An auspicious day was then chosen for entering the examination compound, and the candidates were examined in three sessions. All purified their hearts and cleared their thoughts, seeking to fulfill the court’s eager desire to obtain worthy men. Seventy-five men are entered in this record. They will travel together to the capital and present themselves to the Ministry of Rites, answer before the imperial court, and become ministers of an age of peace.
I, Yuan, have had the good fortune to live under a sage sovereign and to serve in the ranks of educational officials. I too wish to exhaust my modest abilities to contribute even one ten-thousandth toward what is needed. Now, having been granted the privilege of participating in this grand undertaking, I hope to give some small effect to the principle of serving one’s ruler by bringing forward worthy men. Is this not a great honor and good fortune! I, Yuan, reflect that in establishing its institutions, the dynasty has consulted antiquity and honored learning, expounding the Way of Confucius to improve all under Heaven; and the Six Classics, the Analects, and the Mencius…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
之教家傳人誦已百八十年
于茲矣今我
皇上天縱
聖明復隆尊師之禮崇尚儒術表
章經籍而孔子之道益以明
大士之生於斯世者咸得以
文學顯用於時若山東之士
其尤有私幸焉者二其一地
===
隣
京邑漸漬浸沃獨深且厚天下
能同之乎其二生於孔子之
鄉斯文在茲取則不遠天下
能同之乎故雖齊民若總丱
之童猶能言仁義談道德矧
punctuated: 之教，家傳人誦，已百八十年于茲矣。今我皇上天縱聖明，復隆尊師之禮，崇尚儒術，表章經籍，而孔子之道益以明大。士之生於斯世者，咸得以文學顯用於時。若山東之士，其尤有私幸焉者二：其一，地隣京邑，漸漬浸沃，獨深且厚，天下能同之乎？其二，生於孔子之鄉，斯文在茲，取則不遠，天下能同之乎？故雖齊民，若總丱之童，猶能言仁義，談道德，矧
translation_en: …these teachings have been transmitted in every household and recited by everyone for fully one hundred and eighty years now. Our present Emperor, endowed by Heaven with sagely understanding, has further exalted the rites of honoring teachers, promoted Confucian learning, and given prominence to the canonical writings. Thus the Way of Confucius has become ever more illustrious and expansive. Scholars born into this age can all attain distinction and employment through their literary learning. The scholars of Shandong, however, enjoy two particular advantages. First, their land adjoins the imperial capital, and the nurturing influence they receive is exceptionally deep and abundant. Can the rest of the realm share this advantage? Second, they are born in the homeland of Confucius. This cultural tradition resides here, and models to emulate are close at hand. Can the rest of the realm share this advantage? Thus even ordinary people and children with their hair bound in tufts can speak of benevolence and righteousness and discuss the Way and virtue. How much more, then, …

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
士之遊於序庠者是宜其爲
文郁郁洋洋若是乎其盛也
雖然竊觀之往昔由此途以
進者衆矣孰非以能文而見
矚於主司然勲業足以名當
時垂後世固多其人而亦或
有不能盡然者豈文字之美
===
不足以槩其人而其卓然者
要或別有所得固不在於文
字間耶此今日司考校者之
所以不能無懼也古之君子
藴之爲德行言之爲文章發
之爲事業雖所見不同而其
致一也茲七十五人者方其
punctuated: 士之遊於序庠者，是宜其爲文郁郁洋洋，若是乎其盛也。雖然，竊觀之往昔，由此途以進者衆矣，孰非以能文而見矚於主司？然勲業足以名當時、垂後世，固多其人，而亦或有不能盡然者。豈文字之美不足以槩其人，而其卓然者，要或別有所得，固不在於文字間耶？此今日司考校者之所以不能無懼也。古之君子，藴之爲德行，言之爲文章，發之爲事業，雖所見不同，而其致一也。茲七十五人者，方其
translation_en: …how much more so the scholars who study in the schools! It is fitting that their writing should be so richly cultivated and expansive, flourishing to this degree. Yet, looking back at the past, I observe that many have advanced by this route. Was there any who did not attract the attention of the presiding examiners through skill in composition? Certainly, many achieved deeds sufficient to make their names in their own day and transmit them to posterity; yet some did not fully attain this. Could it be that the beauty of a person's writing is insufficient to characterize the person as a whole, and that those who stand out have perhaps attained something else, something that does not lie within written words? This is why those charged with examining and assessing candidates today cannot be without apprehension. For the gentlemen of antiquity, what was cultivated within became virtuous conduct; what was expressed in words became literary composition; and what was put into action became achievement. Although its manifestations differed, its ultimate purport was one. As for these seventy-five men, when they…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
平時讀書商古今其自許何
在於古君子之下今即其所
爲文觀之雖抑揚變化言人
人殊皆能析忠邪之分審王
伯之歸明往古之術辨當世
之務粹然一出於正而不詭
於聖人之道比服有官即其
===
所試於文者而施於有政則
於古人何讓焉主考校者可
以無愧矣不然則靜言庸違
幼學壯倍其所謂善於文者
特緣飾詩書以市進巧售耳
是墮孔氏之訓而干
明主之典大豈惟二三子之羞而
punctuated: 平時讀書，商古今，其自許何在於古君子之下？今即其所爲文觀之，雖抑揚變化，言人人殊，皆能析忠邪之分，審王伯之歸，明往古之術，辨當世之務，粹然一出於正，而不詭於聖人之道。比服有官，即其所試於文者而施於有政，則於古人何讓焉？主考校者可以無愧矣。不然，則靜言庸違，幼學壯倍，其所謂善於文者，特緣飾詩書以市進巧售耳。是墮孔氏之訓，而干明主之典大，豈惟二三子之羞而
translation_en: …in their ordinary reading and weighing of past and present, how could their aspirations place them below the gentlemen of antiquity? Judging now from their compositions, although their emphases and variations differ from person to person, all can distinguish loyalty from treachery, discern the respective tendencies of kingly and hegemonic rule, elucidate the methods of antiquity, and distinguish the pressing concerns of the present age. Their writing proceeds wholly from what is correct and does not depart from the Way of the sages. When they come to hold office, if they apply to government what they have demonstrated in their examination compositions, in what respect need they yield to the ancients? Those responsible for examining them may then be free of shame. Otherwise, they will speak fine words while acting contrary to them, repudiating in maturity what they learned in youth. Their supposed skill in composition will amount merely to embellishing their words with the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents to purchase advancement and cleverly win acceptance. This would subvert the teachings of Confucius and transgress the statutes of an enlightened ruler [the following 大 is unclear]. Would this bring shame only upon you gentlemen, and…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
吾司校文者亦與有辱矣夫
何敢不懼是用以告於二三
子者幸相與勉之是役也右
副都御史今陞大理寺卿駱
顒保釐東土表正士習右僉
都御史方鈍經理河防旌別
士類巡鹽監察御史宋有手
===
印馬監察御史陶欽皐宣猷
飭憲雅尚文教至於涵育薰
陶士類攸賴節浮崇實百度
惟貞則左布政使今陞巡撫
右副都御史應檟實綜理之
工部郎中嚴中員外郎王會
主事陳夢鶴吳衍顧言梁恩
punctuated:
吾司校文者亦與有辱矣，夫何敢不懼？是用以告於二三子者，幸相與勉之。
是役也，右副都御史、今陞大理寺卿駱顒，保釐東土，表正士習；右僉都御史方鈍，經理河防，旌別士類；巡鹽監察御史宋有手、印馬監察御史陶欽皐，宣猷飭憲，雅尚文教。至於涵育薰陶，士類攸賴；節浮崇實，百度惟貞，則左布政使、今陞巡撫右副都御史應檟，實綜理之。工部郎中嚴中、員外郎王會、主事陳夢鶴、吳衍、顧言、梁恩
translation_en:
…we who are charged with evaluating the examination essays would also share in the disgrace. How could we dare not be apprehensive? This is why I offer these words to you gentlemen, hoping that we may encourage one another in this endeavor.
For this examination, Luo Yong 駱顒, Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, now promoted to Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, safeguarded and administered the eastern region and set upright standards for the conduct of scholars. Fang Dun 方鈍, Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief, managed river defenses and distinguished worthy scholars. Song Youshou 宋有手 [?], Investigating Censor for Salt Inspection, and Tao Qingao 陶欽皐, Investigating Censor for Horse Branding, put official plans into effect and enforced regulations, consistently esteeming literary education. As for the nurturing and cultivation upon which scholars depended, the restraint of superficiality and honoring of substance, and the proper ordering of all administrative affairs, these were comprehensively managed by Ying Jia 應檟, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, now promoted to Provincial Governor with the title of Right Vice Censor-in-Chief. Yan Zhong 嚴中, Director in the Ministry of Works; Wang Hui 王會, Vice Director; and Chen Menghe 陳夢鶴, Wu Yan 吳衍, Gu Yan 顧言, and Liang En 梁恩, Secretaries …

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
戶部主事魏〔文洪 攸有年〕
〔公譜 李敬〕行人司行人王〔宗茂〕
皆有事茲土而右布政使
〔湯紹恩〕按察使〔王積〕以履任
至左參政李〔綸〕以部運左參
議劉〔繼德〕僉事吳〔天壽〕都指
揮僉事陳〔惟喬〕以入
===
賀行僉事邵〔梗〕都指揮僉事李
〔寶 蕭國勲〕則協心防範有勞
績焉兵備副使丁〔以忠〕伊〔敏
生 王傳〕僉事孫〔璧 史鶚〕又皆
巽猷肅憲文教有資若右參
議〔榮愷〕副使吳〔嘉會〕郭〔廷冕〕
魏〔良貴〕王〔諮 李乘雲〕僉事賀
punctuated: 戶部主事魏〔文洪 攸有年〕〔公譜 李敬〕、行人司行人王〔宗茂〕，皆有事茲土。而右布政使〔湯紹恩〕、按察使〔王積〕以履任至，左參政李〔綸〕以部運，左參議劉〔繼德〕、僉事吳〔天壽〕、都指揮僉事陳〔惟喬〕以入賀行。僉事邵〔梗〕、都指揮僉事李〔寶 蕭國勲〕，則協心防範，有勞績焉。兵備副使丁〔以忠〕、伊〔敏生 王傳〕、僉事孫〔璧 史鶚〕，又皆巽猷肅憲，文教有資。若右參議〔榮愷〕、副使吳〔嘉會〕、郭〔廷冕〕、魏〔良貴〕、王〔諮 李乘雲〕、僉事賀
translation_en: …and the Ministry of Revenue secretaries Wei Wenhong, You Younian, Gongpu [?], and Li Jing, and Wang Zongmao, a Messenger of the Office of Transmission, all had business in this territory. Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Tang Shaoen and Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Wang Ji arrived to assume office. Left Administration Vice Commissioner Li Lun traveled to supervise transport; Left Administration Assistant Commissioner Liu Jide, Surveillance Assistant Commissioner Wu Tianshou, and Assistant Regional Military Commissioner Chen Weiqiao traveled to court to offer congratulations. Surveillance Assistant Commissioner Shao Geng and Assistant Regional Military Commissioners Li Bao and Xiao Guoxun worked together on preventive safeguards, rendering meritorious service. Surveillance Vice Commissioners for Military Defense Ding Yizhong, Yi Minsheng, and Wang Chuan, together with Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Sun Bi and Shi E, all offered sound counsel [?] and rigorously upheld the law, thereby supporting literary education. As for Right Administration Assistant Commissioner Rong Kai; Surveillance Vice Commissioners Wu Jiahui, Guo Tingmian, Wei Lianggui, Wang Zi, and Li Chengyun; and Surveillance Assistant Commissioner He…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
府各專事一方而咸樂厥成
者例得書之
江西南昌府儒學教授馮元
謹序
punctuated:
府，各專事一方，而咸樂厥成者，例得書之。
江西南昌府儒學教授馮元謹序。
translation_en:
…Fu and the others, each responsible for affairs in one locality and all rejoicing in this accomplishment, may by established practice have their names recorded here.
Preface respectfully written by Feng Yuan, Instructor at the Confucian School of Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi.

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試
監臨官
巡按山東監察御史劉　瑶〔澗甫河南胙城縣人　辛丑進士〕
提調官
山東等處承宣布政使司右參政鮑象賢〔復之直隸歙縣人　己丑進士〕
山東等處承宣布政使司右參議萬虞愷〔懋卿江西南昌縣人　戊戌進士〕
監試官
山東等處提刑按察司副使趙廷松〔子後浙江樂清縣人　癸未進士〕
山東等處提刑按察司僉事李　嵩〔子中直隸歸德衛人　戊戌進士〕
===
考試官
江西南昌府儒學教授馮　元〔大本廣東番禺縣人　辛丑進士〕
湖廣武昌府興國州儒學學正王三聘〔宗尹廣西臨桂縣人　丙午貢士〕
同考試官
浙江紹興府儒學教授梁以衡〔師彥廣東新會縣人　癸卯貢士〕
福建建寧府松溪縣儒學教諭蔡宗堯〔中父浙江臨海縣人　丁酉貢士〕
江西臨江府峽江縣儒學教諭黃應升〔晉卿福建莆田縣人　癸卯貢士〕
直隸鎮江府丹陽縣儒學教諭林允高〔少抑廣東南海縣人　甲午貢士〕
湖廣承天府沔陽州景陵縣儒學教諭袁　道〔文伯雲南太和縣人　癸卯貢士〕
punctuated:
嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試。

監臨官：
巡按山東監察御史劉　瑶〔澗甫，河南胙城縣人，辛丑進士〕。

提調官：
山東等處承宣布政使司右參政鮑象賢〔復之，直隸歙縣人，己丑進士〕。
山東等處承宣布政使司右參議萬虞愷〔懋卿，江西南昌縣人，戊戌進士〕。

監試官：
山東等處提刑按察司副使趙廷松〔子後，浙江樂清縣人，癸未進士〕。
山東等處提刑按察司僉事李　嵩〔子中，直隸歸德衛人，戊戌進士〕。

考試官：
江西南昌府儒學教授馮　元〔大本，廣東番禺縣人，辛丑進士〕。
湖廣武昌府興國州儒學學正王三聘〔宗尹，廣西臨桂縣人，丙午貢士〕。

同考試官：
浙江紹興府儒學教授梁以衡〔師彥，廣東新會縣人，癸卯貢士〕。
福建建寧府松溪縣儒學教諭蔡宗堯〔中父，浙江臨海縣人，丁酉貢士〕。
江西臨江府峽江縣儒學教諭黃應升〔晉卿，福建莆田縣人，癸卯貢士〕。
直隸鎮江府丹陽縣儒學教諭林允高〔少抑，廣東南海縣人，甲午貢士〕。
湖廣承天府沔陽州景陵縣儒學教諭袁　道〔文伯，雲南太和縣人，癸卯貢士〕。
translation_en:

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
子所雅言詩書執禮皆雅言也
誠則形形則著著則明
親親仁也敬長義也無他達之天下也
易
天行健君子以自強不息
安節之亨承上道也
成象之謂乾效法之謂坤
===
昔者聖人之作易也將以順性命之理是
以立天之道曰陰與陽立地之道曰柔
與剛立人之道曰仁與義兼三才而兩
之故易六畫而成卦分陰分陽迭用柔
剛故易六位而成章
書
乃聖乃神乃武乃文
東漸于海西被于流沙朔南暨聲教訖于
四海
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

子所雅言，詩、書、執禮，皆雅言也。
誠則形，形則著，著則明。
親親，仁也；敬長，義也；無他，達之天下也。

易

天行健，君子以自強不息。
安節之亨，承上道也。
成象之謂乾，效法之謂坤。
昔者聖人之作易也，將以順性命之理，是以立天之道曰陰與陽，立地之道曰柔與剛，立人之道曰仁與義。兼三才而兩之，故易六畫而成卦；分陰分陽，迭用柔剛，故易六位而成章。

書

乃聖乃神，乃武乃文。
東漸于海，西被于流沙，朔南暨，聲教訖于四海。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

The subjects of which the Master regularly spoke were the Book of Odes, the Book of Documents, and the observance of ritual; of all these he regularly spoke.
Sincerity takes outward form; taking outward form, it becomes manifest; becoming manifest, it shines forth.
Loving one’s kin is benevolence; respecting one’s elders is righteousness. There is nothing else to do but extend these throughout the world.

Book of Changes (Yijing)

Heaven’s movement is vigorous; the noble man accordingly strives unceasingly to strengthen himself.
The success of resting content in restraint comes from following the way of those above.
Forming images is called Qian; presenting patterns for emulation is called Kun.
When the sages of antiquity made the Book of Changes, they intended thereby to accord with the principles of human nature and destiny. Thus they established the way of Heaven as yin and yang, the way of Earth as yielding and firm, and the way of humanity as benevolence and righteousness. They combined the Three Powers—Heaven, Earth, and humanity—and doubled each; thus, in the Changes, six lines form a hexagram. Distinguishing yin from yang and employing yielding and firm alternately, they made the six positions of the Changes constitute an ordered pattern.

Book of Documents (Shujing)

Sage and spirit-like, martial and cultured.
Eastward his influence reached the sea, westward it extended to Liusha, and it reached north and south; his renown and teaching extended to the Four Seas.

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
而康而色曰予攸好德
三后成功惟殷于民
詩
六月食鬱及薁七月亨葵及菽八月剝棗
十月穫稻爲此春酒以介眉壽七月食
瓜八月斷壺九月叔苴采荼薪樗食我
農夫
俾爾戩穀罄無不宜
天生烝民有物有則民之秉彝好是懿德
===
自堂徂基自羊徂牛鼐鼎及鼒
春秋
冬公會齊侯于防〔隱公九年〕
公及齊大夫盟于蔇〔莊公九年〕九月戊辰諸
侯盟于葵丘〔僖公九年〕
春公孫歸父會楚子于宋　夏五月宋人
及楚人平〔俱宣公十有五年〕
八月晉荀吳帥師滅陸渾之戎〔昭公十有七年〕
禮記
punctuated:
而康而色，曰：「予攸好德。」
三后成功，惟殷于民。

詩
六月食鬱及薁，七月亨葵及菽，八月剝棗，十月穫稻，爲此春酒，以介眉壽。七月食瓜，八月斷壺，九月叔苴，采荼薪樗，食我農夫。
俾爾戩穀，罄無不宜。
天生烝民，有物有則。民之秉彝，好是懿德。
自堂徂基，自羊徂牛，鼐鼎及鼒。

春秋
冬，公會齊侯于防。〔隱公九年〕
公及齊大夫盟于蔇。〔莊公九年〕九月戊辰，諸侯盟于葵丘。〔僖公九年〕
春，公孫歸父會楚子于宋。夏五月，宋人及楚人平。〔俱宣公十有五年〕
八月，晉荀吳帥師滅陸渾之戎。〔昭公十有七年〕

禮記
translation_en:
Compose your countenance and say: “What I cherish is virtue.”
The three lords accomplished their work, bringing abundance to the people.

Book of Odes
In the sixth month we eat wild cherries and wild grapes; in the seventh month we boil mallows and beans; in the eighth month we knock down jujubes; in the tenth month we harvest rice. With it we make the spring wine, to bring the blessing of long life. In the seventh month we eat melons; in the eighth month we cut gourds; in the ninth month we gather hempseed. We gather bitter herbs and cut ailanthus for firewood, to feed our farmers.
May you receive blessings and good fortune, with everything favorable to you.
Heaven gives birth to the multitude of people; for every thing there is a rule. The people hold fast to their constant nature, loving this excellent virtue.
From the hall to the foundation by the gate, from the sheep to the oxen, the large cauldrons, the tripod cauldrons, and the small cauldrons.

Spring and Autumn Annals
In winter, the duke met the Marquis of Qi at Fang. 〔Ninth year of Duke Yin.〕
The duke and the grandees of Qi made a covenant at Ji. 〔Ninth year of Duke Zhuang.〕 In the ninth month, on the wuchen day, the regional lords made a covenant at Kuiqiu. 〔Ninth year of Duke Xi.〕
In spring, Gongsun Guifu met the Viscount of Chu in Song. In summer, in the fifth month, the men of Song and the men of Chu made peace. 〔Both in the fifteenth year of Duke Xuan.〕
In the eighth month, Xun Wu of Jin led an army and destroyed the Luhun Rong. 〔Seventeenth year of Duke Zhao.〕

Book of Rites

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
君天下曰天子朝諸侯分職授政任功曰
予一人
進則揖之退則揚之然後玉鏘鳴也
樂統同禮辨異禮樂之說管乎人情矣
夫祭之爲物大矣其興物備矣順以備者
也其教之本與是故君子之教也外則
教之以尊其君長內則教之以孝於其
親是故明君在上則諸臣服從崇事宗
廟社稷則子孫順孝盡其道端其義而
教生焉
===
第貳場
論
君子之道達諸天
詔誥表內科一道
擬漢令禮官勸學興禮詔〔元朔五年〕
擬唐加左僕射房玄齡太子少師誥〔貞觀十〕
三年
擬宋以胡瑗爲國子監直講謝表〔皇祐四年〕
punctuated:
君天下曰天子，朝諸侯，分職授政，任功，曰予一人。

進則揖之，退則揚之，然後玉鏘鳴也。

樂統同，禮辨異，禮樂之說，管乎人情矣。

夫祭之爲物大矣，其興物備矣，順以備者也，其教之本與！是故君子之教也，外則教之以尊其君長，內則教之以孝於其親。是故明君在上，則諸臣服從；崇事宗廟社稷，則子孫順孝。盡其道，端其義，而教生焉。

第貳場
論
君子之道達諸天。

詔誥表內科一道。
擬漢令禮官勸學興禮詔〔元朔五年〕。
擬唐加左僕射房玄齡太子少師誥〔貞觀十〕三年。
擬宋以胡瑗爲國子監直講謝表〔皇祐四年〕。
translation_en:
He who rules all under Heaven is called the Son of Heaven. When receiving the regional lords at court, assigning offices, conferring responsibilities for government, and entrusting tasks according to merit, he calls himself “I, the One Man.”

When advancing, he bows with hands clasped; when withdrawing, he raises them. Only then do his jade pendants sound in harmony.

Music unifies what is shared; ritual distinguishes differences. The principles of ritual and music encompass human feelings.

Sacrifice is a great undertaking. The things it brings into play are comprehensive; it achieves completeness by following the proper order. Is it not the foundation of instruction? Thus, in the instruction given by the gentleman, people are taught outside the household to honor their rulers and superiors, and within it to be filial toward their parents. Hence, when an enlightened ruler reigns above, his ministers submit and obey; when the ancestral temples and the altars of Soil and Grain are reverently served, sons and grandsons are obedient and filial. By fully realizing this Way and setting its proper meaning aright, instruction arises.

Second Session
Discourse
“The Way of the gentleman reaches to Heaven.”

One topic from among edicts, proclamations, and memorials [?].
Compose an edict in the manner of the Han dynasty ordering the ritual officials to encourage learning and promote ritual observance. 〔Fifth year of Yuanshuo.〕
Compose a proclamation in the manner of the Tang dynasty additionally appointing Fang Xuanling, Vice Director of the Left, as Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent. 〔Thirteenth year of Zhenguan; the transcription places “third year” outside the annotation.〕
Compose a memorial of thanks in the manner of the Song dynasty for the appointment of Hu Yuan as Instructor in the Directorate of Education. 〔Fourth year of Huangyou.〕

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
判語〔五條〕
官員赴任過限
丁夫差遣不平
致祭祀典神祇
縱放軍人歇役
官司出入人罪
第三場
策〔五道〕
問農桑王業根本自古享國長久獨稱周
===
曆論者歸美於后稷農業開基後世躬
親耕織以爲能重民衣食之源信矣今
考其制〔孟〕春天子帥公卿大夫耕于南
郊而推撥有數饗勞有別穜稑有藏者
其儀也仲春詔后帥內外命婦蠶于北
郊而卜覩有禁獻受有度築浴有所者
其儀也可詳指而言歟迨漢唐宋耕耤
之君親蠶之后史傳所載代不絕書其
間果有能知民事之不容緩禮制之所
punctuated:
判語〔五條〕
官員赴任過限。
丁夫差遣不平。
致祭祀典神祇。
縱放軍人歇役。
官司出入人罪。

第三場
策〔五道〕
問：農桑，王業根本。自古享國長久，獨稱周曆，論者歸美於后稷農業開基，後世躬親耕織，以爲能重民衣食之源，信矣。今考其制，〔孟〕春天子帥公卿大夫耕于南郊，而推撥有數，饗勞有別，穜稑有藏者，其儀也。仲春詔后帥內外命婦蠶于北郊，而卜覩有禁，獻受有度，築浴有所者，其儀也。可詳指而言歟？迨漢唐宋，耕耤之君、親蠶之后，史傳所載，代不絕書。其間果有能知民事之不容緩、禮制之所
translation_en:
Legal judgments〔five items〕
An official exceeds the permitted time for taking up his post.
Laborers are assigned corvée duties inequitably.
Sacrifices are offered to deities included in the sacrificial canon.
Soldiers are allowed to leave and cease performing their duties.
Judicial authorities wrongfully impose or remove criminal liability.

Third Session
Policy questions〔five questions〕
Question: Agriculture and sericulture are the foundation of kingly rule. Among states that endured long from antiquity onward, Zhou alone is singled out for the length of its reign. Commentators attribute this achievement to Hou Ji’s establishment of its foundations through agriculture, and to later rulers’ personal participation in plowing and weaving, regarding these acts as showing due regard for the sources of the people’s clothing and food. This is indeed so.

Now, examining the regulations: in the 〔first month of〕 spring, the Son of Heaven led the Three Dukes, ministers, and grand masters in plowing in the southern suburb. The prescribed number of pushes and movements of the plow [?], distinctions in the feasting and rewarding of participants, and the storage of late- and early-ripening grain seeds constituted the ceremonial observances. In the second month of spring, the queen was commanded to lead the titled women of the inner and outer courts in tending silkworms in the northern suburb. Restrictions concerning divination and viewing [?], prescribed measures for presenting and receiving offerings, and designated places for constructing facilities and bathing silkworm eggs [?] constituted the ceremonial observances. Can you identify and explain these in detail?

In the Han, Tang, and Song dynasties, rulers who plowed the imperial field and empresses who personally tended silkworms appear in the historical records without a break from dynasty to dynasty. Among them, were there indeed any who understood that the people’s work could not admit delay, and what the ritual institutions …

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
當因足可稱述者歟洪惟我
太祖高皇帝創造
鴻業加意農桑但請元年之
詔有曰籍田千畝所以供粢盛備饋膳首舉行
之以爲天下勸曰民間但有隙地皆令
種桑以爲禦寒之具其諸
諭廷臣
諭戶部
聖言具在歷歷可述
耕藉田饗先農集禮所載班班可考眞能開
丕基於無窮而陋近代於不居者遐哉不可
尚已
===
列聖相承守爲家法若
成祖文皇帝務本訓之作
宣宗章皇帝織婦詞之賦皆能崇實嗣徽而保
大
帝業者也肆我
皇上御極培植根本乃於
punctuated:
當因，足可稱述者歟？洪惟我太祖高皇帝創造鴻業，加意農桑。但請元年之詔有曰：「籍田千畝，所以供粢盛、備饋膳，首舉行之，以爲天下勸。」曰：「民間但有隙地，皆令種桑，以爲禦寒之具。」其諸諭廷臣、諭戶部，聖言具在，歷歷可述。耕藉田、饗先農，《集禮》所載，班班可考。眞能開丕基於無窮，而陋近代於不居者，遐哉！不可尚已！
列聖相承，守爲家法。若成祖文皇帝《務本訓》之作、宣宗章皇帝《織婦詞》之賦，皆能崇實嗣徽，而保大帝業者也。肆我皇上御極，培植根本，乃於
translation_en:
…which ritual institutions ought to be followed, and whose achievements merit praise and recounting? Reverently considering our Emperor Taizu Gao, he founded the great imperial enterprise and devoted particular attention to farming and sericulture. The edict of the first year [the preceding wording is doubtful: 但請, ?] states: “The thousand mu of ritual fields supply grain for sacrificial offerings and provisions for meals. Let their cultivation be undertaken first, to encourage all under Heaven.” It also states: “Wherever the people have unused ground, have them plant mulberries, to provide the means of protection against the cold.” His various instructions to court officials and to the Ministry of Revenue survive in full; these sagely words can be recounted distinctly. His plowing of the ritual fields and offerings to the First Farmer are clearly recorded and verifiable in the Collected Rituals. Truly, he established a mighty foundation for all time and left recent dynasties far behind, without resting on his achievements. How lofty! He cannot be surpassed!
The successive sage emperors inherited these practices and maintained them as the ruling house’s established norms. Emperor Chengzu Wen’s composition of Instructions on Attending to the Fundamentals and Emperor Xuanzong Zhang’s composition of the Song of the Weaving Woman both honored practical endeavor and continued their predecessor’s excellence, thereby preserving and enlarging the imperial enterprise. Now our reigning emperor has ascended the throne and nurtured the foundations; thus, at …

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
內苑之西並舉
親耕親蠶之典而又建
無逸殿豳風亭以時觀省
製斅祇蠶壇賦以示隆重規度超曠
宸翰輝煌蓋遠邁周王而近宏
列祖矣豈非所以衍
寶曆於億萬年無疆之休也哉邇者瑞麥秀於
畿甸嘉禾生於
西苑
===
聖德之感格
天心之篤貺可徵也已諸士涵濡治化稽古禮
文其悉著於篇以觀對揚之學
問昔人有言學者貴有所疑有疑然後能
無疑然則讀聖人之書未有不先於疑
而後能無疑者也古之載籍燬於秦火
之後其可疑者多矣而理之尤可疑者
莫甚於周禮或疑設官分職之異於周
官或疑列爵分土之殊於王制或疑考
punctuated:
內苑之西，並舉親耕親蠶之典，而又建無逸殿、豳風亭，以時觀省，製斅祇蠶壇賦，以示隆重。規度超曠，宸翰輝煌，蓋遠邁周王，而近宏列祖矣。豈非所以衍寶曆於億萬年無疆之休也哉！邇者瑞麥秀於畿甸，嘉禾生於西苑，聖德之感格、天心之篤貺，可徵也已。諸士涵濡治化，稽古禮文，其悉著於篇，以觀對揚之學。

問：昔人有言：「學者貴有所疑，有疑然後能無疑。」然則讀聖人之書，未有不先於疑而後能無疑者也。古之載籍燬於秦火之後，其可疑者多矣，而理之尤可疑者，莫甚於《周禮》。或疑設官分職之異於《周官》，或疑列爵分土之殊於《王制》，或疑考
translation_en:
…to the west of the inner imperial gardens, jointly instituted the ceremonies of personally plowing and personally tending silkworms. He further built the Hall of No Ease and the Pavilion of the Airs of Bin, for observation and reflection at appropriate times, and composed the Rhapsody on the Silkworm Altar [?], demonstrating the solemn importance he accorded these matters. His designs are magnificent and far-reaching; his imperial calligraphy shines resplendently. He has surely far surpassed the king of Zhou of antiquity and enlarged the achievements of his more recent imperial ancestors. Is this not the means of extending the boundless blessings of the imperial succession for countless millions of years? Recently, auspicious wheat has put forth ears in the capital region, and auspicious grain has grown in the Western Garden. Here is evidence of the power of his sagely virtue to move Heaven and of Heaven’s generous bestowal of blessings. You gentlemen, nurtured by this transforming governance and versed in ancient ritual texts, should set forth all your views in writing, so that we may assess your learning in responding to and extolling the imperial charge.

Question: Someone of old said, “What matters for a student is to have doubts; only after having doubts can one become free of doubt.” Thus, in reading the books of the sages, no one can arrive at freedom from doubt without first experiencing doubt. After ancient writings were destroyed in the Qin book burning, many matters in them became open to doubt. Yet among those whose principles are especially open to doubt, none exceeds the Rites of Zhou. Some question why its establishment of offices and allocation of duties differ from those in the “Offices of Zhou”; others question why its ordering of ranks and division of territory differ from those in the “Royal Regulations”; still others question the…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
工記之不足以補冬官或疑冬官之散
見於他屬或以寺人之屬冢宰爲疑或
以賓客之屬司寇爲疑或以國服爲息
爲疑或以屬民讀法爲疑至如米鹽絲
枲之疑於細盟詛讐仇之疑於亂廛人
五布之疑於苛載師賈田之疑於泛是
皆可疑之大者也是以古之論者或以
六國陰謀之書疑之或以漢儒附會之
書疑之或疑其爲成周理財之書或疑
===
其爲瀆亂不經之書然亦有信之而不
疑者或欲執此以往或以爲眞聖人之
作或謂之周公致太平之書或謂之聖
賢制作之書此果何所見而不以爲疑
歟其信之而用之者或行之而無益於
治或議之而不果於行此尤其可疑者
也夫有所疑而不思所以辯之則是終
於疑而不解也諸士子考之以尚存之
文參之以他經之旨以求通其未明之
punctuated: 工記之不足以補冬官，或疑冬官之散見於他屬，或以寺人之屬冢宰爲疑，或以賓客之屬司寇爲疑，或以國服爲息爲疑，或以屬民讀法爲疑。至如米鹽絲枲之疑於細，盟詛讐仇之疑於亂，廛人五布之疑於苛，載師賈田之疑於泛，是皆可疑之大者也。是以古之論者，或以六國陰謀之書疑之，或以漢儒附會之書疑之，或疑其爲成周理財之書，或疑其爲瀆亂不經之書。然亦有信之而不疑者，或欲執此以往，或以爲眞聖人之作，或謂之周公致太平之書，或謂之聖賢制作之書。此果何所見而不以爲疑歟？其信之而用之者，或行之而無益於治，或議之而不果於行，此尤其可疑者也。夫有所疑而不思所以辯之，則是終於疑而不解也。諸士子考之以尚存之文，參之以他經之旨，以求通其未明之
translation_en:
…the Record of Artificers being inadequate to supply the missing section on the Ministry of Winter; others question why the offices of the Ministry of Winter appear scattered among other departments. Some question why palace eunuchs fall under the Minister of State, or why guests fall under the Minister of Justice. Some question the use of state service obligations as the basis for interest charges, or the assembling of the people to read the laws to them. As for provisions concerning rice, salt, silk, and hemp, these are suspected of excessive minuteness; those concerning covenants, curses, and vengeance, of fostering disorder; the five market levies collected by the Market Tax Collector, of excessive severity; and the merchant fields administered by the Land Allotment Officer, of excessive breadth. These are all major points open to doubt.

Thus, among earlier commentators, some questioned the Rites of Zhou as a book of covert schemes from the Six States, while others questioned it as a book pieced together through forced interpretations by Han scholars. Some suspected it was a book on financial administration in the Zhou kingdom; others, a book of improprieties and disorder contrary to canonical norms. Yet there were also those who trusted it without question. Some wished to take it as their guide in proceeding; some considered it truly the work of a sage. Some called it the book through which the Duke of Zhou brought about perfect peace; others called it a book of institutions established by sages and worthies. What, indeed, did they perceive that left them without doubt?

Among those who trusted it and put it to use, some implemented it without benefiting government; others discussed it but never carried it into practice. This is especially grounds for doubt. If one has doubts but does not consider how to resolve them through discrimination, one will remain in doubt without understanding. You candidates should examine it against the surviving text and compare it with the purport of the other classics, seeking to comprehend its as-yet-unclarified…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
意則周禮之書固有不必疑者請悉言
之以折衷諸儒之論
問儒者之名其來遠矣漢有經術節義之
尚而得宗於孔子者何人唐有詞騷疏
奏之章而功比於孟子者何氏至於宋
儒有廬山講學人謂不由師傳然歟否
歟有純粹比顏又謂才不及孟是歟非
歟一變至道儒也何以曰早悅孫吳探
窩躡根藥也何以曰志勵堅苦勁挺不
===
屈至誠斂德二子師資於何賢有德有
言自然成法二賢宗統於何學有學去
矜字而識透義利之關有學得仁字而
深明理欲之限有清德重望皎如日星
有博學強行堅如金石有倡道於發而
號一代宗師有隱居象山而授生徒數
百有父子相傳而明體用之學有祖孫
相繼而發理數之旨有以一心而窮造
化之原以一身而體天地之道茲皆儒
punctuated:
意，則《周禮》之書固有不必疑者。請悉言之，以折衷諸儒之論。
問：儒者之名，其來遠矣。漢有經術節義之尚，而得宗於孔子者何人？唐有詞騷疏奏之章，而功比於孟子者何氏？至於宋儒，有廬山講學，人謂不由師傳，然歟否歟？有純粹比顏，又謂才不及孟，是歟非歟？一變至道，儒也，何以曰早悅孫吳？探窩躡根，藥也，何以曰志勵堅苦、勁挺不屈？至誠斂德，二子師資於何賢？有德有言，自然成法，二賢宗統於何學？有學去矜字而識透義利之關，有學得仁字而深明理欲之限，有清德重望皎如日星，有博學強行堅如金石，有倡道於發而號一代宗師，有隱居象山而授生徒數百，有父子相傳而明體用之學，有祖孫相繼而發理數之旨，有以一心而窮造化之原、以一身而體天地之道，茲皆儒
translation_en:
…meaning, then there are surely things in the Rites of Zhou that need not be doubted. Please explain these fully, thereby adjudicating among the arguments of the various scholars.
Question: The designation “Confucian scholar” has a long history. In the Han, learning in the Classics and steadfast moral integrity were esteemed: who succeeded in taking Confucius as his master? In the Tang, there were compositions in the forms of ornate verse, poetry in the Sao tradition, and memorials to the throne: whose achievements were comparable to those of Mengzi? As for the Song scholars, one lectured at Lushan, and people said that his learning had not been transmitted by a teacher. Was this so or not? One was compared to Yan Hui in purity, yet was also said to fall short of Mengzi in ability. Was this right or wrong? One was a Confucian scholar who could, with a single transformation, attain the Way: why was it said that he early delighted in Sun and Wu? Of one, the text says, “searching out the lair and tracing the roots—medicine” [?]: why was it said that his resolve was tempered by hardship and that he stood firm and unyielding? Regarding utmost sincerity and the cultivation of virtue, under which worthy did these two masters study? Possessing virtue and words of enduring worth, and naturally becoming models: in which learning did these two worthies’ intellectual lineage originate? There was one whose learning eliminated conceit and who thoroughly understood the dividing line between righteousness and profit; one whose learning grasped benevolence and who deeply understood the boundary between principle and desire; one whose pure virtue and great reputation shone like the sun and stars; one whose broad learning and steadfast practice were firm as metal and stone; one who advocated the Way in Fa [?] and was called the master of an age; one who lived in retirement at Xiangshan and taught several hundred students; a father and son who transmitted their learning and elucidated substance and function; a grandfather and grandson who carried on one another’s work and expounded the purport of principle and number; and one who, through his own mind, fathomed the source of creation and transformation, and through his own person embodied the Way of Heaven and Earth. These were all Confucian scholars…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
之表表者而其中以何者爲準耶洪惟
我
朝
天啓文明氣運隆盛教化浹洽名世之儒彬彬
迭見諸士子誦習古訓必折衷有素矣
盍詳對於篇以觀願學之志
問自孔子而下著書言道學者莫詳於子
思中庸之首章楊氏所謂一篇之體要
也其論入道之方曰戒謹不覩恐懼不
===
聞者所以立其本也其曰愼其獨者緊
之大學特誠意之一目耳韓退之作原
道語誠意而不及格物致知遂有以來
朱子之譏然則此章猶有遺論歟何以
能致中和臻位育也及其中篇有忠恕
近道之說有達德行達道之說有明善
誠身之說有致曲之說有尊德性而道
問學之說既詳且備矣末乃括一篇之
意而再叙之亦不過爲己謹獨之事而
punctuated:
之表表者，而其中以何者爲準耶？洪惟我朝，天啓文明，氣運隆盛，教化浹洽，名世之儒彬彬迭見。諸士子誦習古訓，必折衷有素矣。盍詳對於篇，以觀願學之志？

問：自孔子而下，著書言道，學者莫詳於子思。《中庸》之首章，楊氏所謂一篇之體要也。其論入道之方，曰戒謹不覩、恐懼不聞者，所以立其本也。其曰愼其獨者，緊之《大學》，特誠意之一目耳。韓退之作《原道》，語誠意而不及格物致知，遂有以來朱子之譏。然則此章猶有遺論歟？何以能致中和、臻位育也？及其中篇，有忠恕近道之說，有達德行達道之說，有明善誠身之說，有致曲之說，有尊德性而道問學之說，既詳且備矣。末乃括一篇之意而再叙之，亦不過爲己謹獨之事而
translation_en:
…the outstanding figures among Confucian scholars. Yet which among them should serve as the standard? We reverently reflect that, under our dynasty, Heaven has ushered in cultural enlightenment; the fortunes of the age flourish, and moral instruction permeates all. Distinguished Confucian scholars renowned in their age have appeared in elegant succession. You candidates, through reciting and studying the teachings of antiquity, must long since have formed considered judgments. Why not reply fully in your essays, so that we may discern your aspiration to learn?

Question: From Confucius onward, among scholars who wrote books expounding the Way, none was more thorough than Zisi. The opening chapter of the Doctrine of the Mean is what Master Yang called the essential framework of the whole work. In discussing how to enter the Way, its injunction to exercise caution over what one does not see and apprehension over what one does not hear serves to establish the foundation. Its injunction to be watchful over oneself when alone, when compared with the Great Learning [?], amounts merely to the single item of making the intentions sincere. Han Tuizhi, in writing An Inquiry into the Way, spoke of making the intentions sincere but did not address investigating things and extending knowledge, thereby drawing Master Zhu’s criticism. Does this chapter, then, likewise leave something undiscussed? How can it bring equilibrium and harmony to their fullest realization, so that Heaven and Earth take their proper places and the myriad things are nurtured? In its middle portion, there are discussions of loyalty and reciprocity as being close to the Way; of practicing the universally binding Way through the universally binding virtues; of understanding goodness and making oneself sincere; of developing goodness from particular beginnings; and of honoring one’s moral nature while pursuing inquiry and learning. These are both detailed and comprehensive. At the end, however, it gathers together and restates the meaning of the entire work, yet this too amounts merely to learning for one’s own moral cultivation and being watchful over oneself when alone…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
已然則入道之方果不外於謹獨也歟
而大學之條目何以次之格致之後也
中篇又何以有數端之說也古人謂千
聖一心萬古一道又曰譬如千蹊萬徑
皆可適國但得一道而入則可以推類
而通其餘矣豈其立說不同皆可以入
道而未必其盡合也耶抑可以會而通
之本無二致也耶請究言之以觀至當
歸一之學
===
問屯田水利鹽法馬政皆足國安邊之不
可闕者粤稽諸古田金城田許下田河
中田豐州皆著有成效而齊青曾兗之
屯未盡闢也一遇歲歉則民逋矣何以
撫之引芍波引腴口引汾水引渭渠皆
行有顯績而汶泗徂泰之泉未盡濬也
一遇乾旱則流竭矣何以拯之或產於
井或產於池或產於土或產於海鹽之
爲利溥矣何商人苦於壅滯固有梢引
punctuated:
已。然則入道之方，果不外於謹獨也歟？而大學之條目，何以次之格致之後也？中篇又何以有數端之說也？古人謂：「千聖一心，萬古一道。」又曰：「譬如千蹊萬徑，皆可適國，但得一道而入，則可以推類而通其餘矣。」豈其立說不同，皆可以入道，而未必其盡合也耶？抑可以會而通之，本無二致也耶？請究言之，以觀至當歸一之學。

問：屯田、水利、鹽法、馬政，皆足國安邊之不可闕者。粤稽諸古，田金城，田許下，田河中，田豐州，皆著有成效，而齊青曾兗之屯未盡闢也。一遇歲歉，則民逋矣，何以撫之？引芍波，引腴口，引汾水，引渭渠，皆行有顯績，而汶泗徂泰之泉未盡濬也。一遇乾旱，則流竭矣，何以拯之？或產於井，或產於池，或產於土，或產於海，鹽之爲利溥矣。何商人苦於壅滯，固有梢引
translation_en:
…that is all. Does the method of entering the Way, then, truly consist solely in vigilance when alone? Why, then, do the ordered steps in the Great Learning place it after the investigation of things and the extension of knowledge? And why does the middle portion of the Doctrine of the Mean offer several distinct formulations? The ancients said, “The thousand sages share one mind; through all ages there is one Way.” They also said, “It is like a thousand trails and ten thousand paths, all of which can lead to the capital: once one finds a route and enters by it, one can reason by analogy and comprehend the rest.” Could it be that their formulations differ and all permit entry into the Way, without necessarily agreeing in every respect? Or can they be brought together and understood as interconnected, fundamentally admitting of no divergence? Please examine this fully, so that we may assess your learning concerning the supremely fitting principle in which all converge.

Question: Agricultural colonies, water conservancy, salt administration, and horse administration are all indispensable to enriching the state and securing the frontiers. Looking back to antiquity, the cultivation of land at Jincheng, Xuxia, Hezhong, and Fengzhou all produced conspicuous results. Yet the agricultural colonies of Qi, Qing, Zeng [?], and Yan have not been fully opened up. Whenever a poor harvest occurs, the people flee. How can they be cared for and reassured? Diversions from Shaobo [?], Yukou [?], the Fen River, and the Wei Canal all achieved notable results. Yet the springs of the Wen and Si rivers and of Mounts Cu and Tai have not been fully dredged. Whenever drought occurs, their streams run dry. How can relief be provided? Salt is produced from wells, lakes, soil, and the sea: its benefits are widespread. Why, then, do merchants suffer from impediments to its circulation, with some already disposing of their salt certificates [?]…

title: 嘉靖二十八年山東鄉試錄
text:
而去者矣招之可無其術乎或養於民
或養於官或養於監或養於農馬之爲
制詳矣何馬戶困於誅求固有棄馬而
逃者矣綏之可無其道乎茲欲田闢而
歲不能災水治而河不能患財裕於鹽
而不價兵强於馬而不弱爾多士必有
濟時之上策也宜盡言以對
punctuated: 而去者矣。招之可無其術乎？或養於民，或養於官，或養於監，或養於農，馬之爲制詳矣。何馬戶困於誅求，固有棄馬而逃者矣？綏之可無其道乎？茲欲田闢而歲不能災，水治而河不能患，財裕於鹽而不價，兵强於馬而不弱，爾多士必有濟時之上策也，宜盡言以對。
translation_en: …and departed. Can there be no means of attracting them back? Horses are raised by the people, by officials, by the horse-breeding directorates, or by farmers: the regulations governing horses are comprehensive indeed. Why, then, are horse-rearing households burdened by oppressive exactions, so that some have actually abandoned their horses and fled? Can there be no way to bring them security? We now wish to have fields opened so that bad years cannot bring disaster; waterways regulated so that rivers cannot cause harm; revenue enriched through salt without raising prices [?]; and the army strengthened through horses so that it is not weak. You assembled scholars surely have excellent policies for meeting the needs of the times. Set them forth fully in your replies.

translation_en:
Seventy-five successful provincial graduates (juren).

First: Liu Dazhang, a student of the Qingzhou Prefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.
Second: Zhang Yi, a student of the Dengzhou Prefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Third: Tian Ren, a student of the Gaotang Subprefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Fourth: Yang Zhengmai, a student of the Jiaozhou Subprefectural School. His examination classic was the Spring and Autumn Annals.
Fifth: Zhang Jiu [?], a student of the Qingcheng County School. His examination classic was the Book of Rites.
Sixth: Chen Guanghui, a student of the Mengyin County School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Seventh: Wang Shou, a student of the En County School. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Eighth: Zhen Pei, a student of the Yutai County School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Ninth: Su Jun, a student of the Puzhou Subprefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.
Tenth: Yu Zhong, an attached student of the Shouguang County School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Eleventh: Cao Yilin, an attached student of the Anqiu County School. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Twelfth: Wang Chayan, a student of the Chaocheng County School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Thirteenth: Fu Qi, a student of the Yuncheng County School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.
Fourteenth: Chen Yuanji, an attached student of the Jining Subprefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Fifteenth: Cui Kongxin, an added-quota student of the Binzhou Subprefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Sixteenth: Pan Zikuan, a student of the Jinan Prefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
